name: Veterans Memorial State Forest Campground
evidence: midnrreservations site map: 24 sites in three loops inland, Platte River only off to the east; no site tagged Adjacent To water. Wayback z19 at 44.6585,-85.9450: nearest (east) loop pads ~45-55 m from the river through forest. Old pin was the US-31 bridge ~230 m NE

name: Weber Lake State Forest Campground
evidence: Wayback z18 2017-03 (campers visible) at 45.2995,-84.7215: pads ~45-55 m back from Weber Lake behind wooded bank; 3DEP pads 273.6 vs lake 266.7 (DNR stairway down). Bluff, not on-water; lakeview kept, canopy prevents a downgrade. Old pin ~130 m SE in forest

name: W.J. Hayes State Park Campground
evidence: Esri at 42.0675,-84.1290: both loops sit ~250+ m S of Round Lake through forest, with the day-use lot/launch between. midnrreservations: no site tagged Adjacent To lake, no per-site lake text. Old pin was the day-use lot ~550 m NW

name: Wagner Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov per-site coords on Wayback z19 (0.21 m/px, 2017/2023/2026): nearest pads (5, 7) ~30-45 m from the high-water line behind a pine band; the wide sand is exposed lakebed at low water. No Proximity-to-Water attribute on any of the 12 sites

name: Waterloo Recreation Area - Portage Lake Campground
evidence: Esri leaf-off at 42.3305,-84.2345: loops ~70 m+ from Portage Lake behind a wooded bluff/marsh fringe. midnrreservations per-site text: lakeside sites 'back to the woods', 'lake is not visible'; the beach/vista walkways are separate. Only Green Lake GL sites tagged Lake

name: Yankee Springs Recreation Area - Deep Lake Rustic Campground
evidence: midnrreservations per-site text: drive-in D46-49, D51-52, D69-72 (30-55 ft) 'Site has a view of the lake', and the map puts them on the loop tips nearest Deep Lake. Esri leaf-off at 42.6180,-85.4570: west loop ~45 m back on a wooded bluff (3DEP 259 vs lake 246), so view, not on-water

name: Wilson State Park Campground
evidence: DNR Wilson_Campground_Map.pdf: sites 1-14 and 122-135 front Budd Lake with 'steps down to lake'; midnrreservations tags 1-8,10,12,25,129-133 'lakefront'. Wayback z19 + 3DEP: pads ~25-45 m back atop a ~10 m wooded bank (349 vs 339). Bluff caps it at view

name: Yankee Springs Recreation Area - Gun Lake Modern Campground
evidence: Esri at 42.6160,-85.5190: RVs on the channel-side row parked ~10-15 m from Gun Lake's shore across open grass with boats tied at the bank. midnrreservations tags the channel row Waterfront (48-70 even, 72, 76, 78). Old pin was forest ~400 m NE
